default_port_notes.8080: Grafana Mimir HTTP API (default --server.http-listen-port) — query + push live UNDER the /prometheus path prefix here
default_port_notes.7946: memberlist gossip ring (cluster membership) — NOT HTTP

auth_default: X-Scope-OrgID-required (multitenancy enabled by default; tenant identity, not authentication)
auth_config_env: -auth.multitenancy-enabled=true (DEFAULT) -> every request MUST carry X-Scope-OrgID or it is rejected with 'no org id'
-auth.multitenancy-enabled=false -> tenant forced to literal 'anonymous' (single-tenant, no real auth)
Real auth delegated to a gateway (grafana/mimir gateway, nginx, oauth2-proxy) — Mimir core only routes on the header
install_tell: mimir -config.file=mimir.yml ; grafana/mimir:X.Y.Z ; HTTP on :8080 with /prometheus prefix
misconfig_patterns: Query API lives UNDER /prometheus/* — a bare /api/v1/query returns 404 (Mimir-distinctive path-shape tell vs Prometheus/VM which serve /api/v1/* at root)
X-Scope-OrgID is identity, NOT a secret — anyone supplying a valid/guessed tenant ID ('anonymous','demo','1') reads that tenant's series
-auth.multitenancy-enabled=false collapses everything to tenant 'anonymous' — header-less reads return data
/config and /runtime_config return the full running config (object-store creds, per-tenant limits)
/distributor/ring, /ingester/ring, /store-gateway/ring, /compactor/ring expose ring membership + internal node IPs
/api/v1/push accepts remote-write — unauth metric injection into a named tenant
Mimir DROPPED Cortex's /distributor/all_user_stats roster route — tenant enumeration is harder than Cortex (a Mimir-vs-Cortex discriminator)

active_probe.false_positive_check: POSITIVE Mimir discriminator (conjunctive): (1) query API is served at /prometheus/api/v1/* — a bare /api/v1/query 404s while /prometheus/api/v1/query works; Prometheus and VM serve /api/v1/* at ROOT, so the 404-at-root + 200-under-/prometheus shape is Mimir/GEM-unique among the family. (2) A header-less request to /prometheus/api/v1/query returns the 'no org id' error (SHARED with Cortex — disambiguate: Mimir has NO /distributor/all_user_stats; Mimir exposes /store-gateway/ring + /compactor/ring + /multitenant_alertmanager/status which Cortex's older route set lacks). buildinfo: real Mimir returns goVersion (it is built on the Prometheus codebase); the differentiator from Prometheus is the /prometheus path prefix + ring routes + cortex_/mimir_ /metrics, NOT the buildinfo shape.

shodan_dorks.no_org_id: (Censys — 'no org id' is a non-200 body the Shodan web UI under-indexes; route the X-Scope-OrgID-missing tell to Censys http body / header search)

deployment_tells: Query API under /prometheus/* (and rules under /prometheus/config/v1/rules) — the path-prefix shift is the headline Mimir tell
Ring admin routes for ALL dskit components: /distributor/ring, /ingester/ring, /store-gateway/ring, /compactor/ring — Mimir (and GEM) expose the full set
/multitenant_alertmanager/status is Mimir-specific (Cortex names it differently / older)
/metrics exposes cortex_* AND mimir_* internal metrics (Mimir kept the cortex_ prefix on many metrics for back-compat — a fingerprint subtlety)
pivot_paths: GET /prometheus/api/v1/query?query=up with a guessed X-Scope-OrgID -> that tenant's target inventory (read surface)
GET /config + /runtime_config -> object-store credentials + per-tenant limits + override list (tenant IDs leak here even without all_user_stats)
GET /ingester/ring + /store-gateway/ring -> ring node membership + internal IPs -> backend topology
POST /api/v1/push with X-Scope-OrgID -> unauth metric injection (write surface — SEPARATE severity)
vulnerabilities: Design choice (NOT a CVE): X-Scope-OrgID is identity not credential; tenant isolation depends on an upstream gateway operators frequently omit

CVE-2024-24789, CVE-2025-22870, CVE-2025-22871, CVE-2025-61727, CVE-2025-61729 against grafana-mimir images are Go-stdlib/dependency-class (resolved by Go version bumps in 2.16.x/2.17.x), NOT Mimir application-logic vulns
Mimir 3.0 (Nov 2025) shipped a redesigned architecture — verify port/path set against the running major version
auth_default_thesis: TENANT-IDENTITY-DEFAULT (multitenancy ON by default). Like Cortex, a bare /api/v1/query (here /prometheus/api/v1/query) without X-Scope-OrgID is rejected, so a naive dork reads as 'protected.' But the header is identity, not a secret: -auth.multitenancy-enabled=false -> 'anonymous' single-tenant collapse, and guessable org IDs read real data. Mimir is HARDER to enumerate than Cortex (no all_user_stats), so the tenant roster leaks via /config/runtime_config instead. The auth-on-default thesis must be scored at the tenant-guess + config-leak layer, not the bare-query 401, for this platform.
research_questions: What share of exposed Mimir run -auth.multitenancy-enabled=false ('anonymous' -> header-less read)?
Do guessable org IDs (anonymous/demo/1) return real series on multitenancy-enabled hosts?
How often do /config + /runtime_config leak object-store credentials and the tenant override roster?
Does the /prometheus-prefix 404-at-root shape cleanly separate Mimir from Prometheus/VM at population scale?
Mimir 3.0 vs 2.x: did the redesign move ports/paths enough to break the 2.x fingerprint?
